exact_statement: For the actual Boolean family F_r in PROOF.md, for all even r>=4, with epsilon=2^-r, means (1/2,0,-1/2), three-cut weights (5/16,3/16,5/16), R=sum_j(1-m_j^2)phi(q_j), queried influence d=epsilon/2, and E=Delta_s H(F_r)-sum_j w_j Delta_s H(1-2C_j)-Delta_s R, E/d=r/4+3/(4 ln 2)-7/4+o(1), while the actual source-spectrum JS release Delta_s J/d=3/4+O(epsilon). Under the one original cut policy s then the r controller bits, every least nonnegative C=1 cut reserve has zero unused root slack. Hence no fixed finite K,A>=0 bounds E by Kd+A Delta_s J plus that unused weighted cut slack. The node is reached with probability 1/4 by two actual DATA tag exposures from an equal-mean predecessor, with the same harmonic cut bank and both children retained. This refutes only that local unequal-mean payment upgrade: H(F_r)/I(F_r)<=16.
hypotheses: Uniform cube; normalized Walsh spectrum; base-2 entropy.
Canonical even-dimensional bent controller and disjoint private point-defect, majority, negative point-defect cores as defined in PROOF.md.
All three original cuts, their actual physical children, fixed-policy Bellman continuations, rarity and complete source/structural terminal costs retained.
Unused slack is for C=1, not an assertion for arbitrary cut-bank coefficient.

proof_dependencies.use: Definitions and equal-mean boundary only; no unequal-mean payment assumed.
Exact T+J+Lstr decomposition reconstructed here; its universal spending claim is not enlarged.
